# Recommendation Memo

**To:** Marisol Rivera, Rivera Dental  **From:** ___  **Date:** 2026-08-24
**Re:** Where to start

## What you asked for

1. The phone — "Danny is on the phone all day and meanwhile there's a patient
   standing right there at the counter waiting to check out."
2. No-shows — eleven last month, "every one is an hour of a chair sitting empty."
3. Insurance verification — "twenty minutes a patient sometimes."
4. The website redone.
5. TikTok.

You also said two things I am treating as requirements, not preferences: **no robot
talking to your patients like they're not people** — "these are families I've known
for fifteen years" — and **nothing where Danny has to learn a whole new system.**

## What I recommend building first

**Appointment reminders — automatic, the day before, by text.**

**Why this one:** eleven no-shows last month, each one an empty hygiene hour.
Danny already does this by hand and the reason it fails is honest — "I usually don't
have time." Nobody has to learn anything, no patient talks to a machine, and it is
the smallest change that shows up in your day.

**Why not the phone yet:** it is the loudest problem and I believe it is real —
Danny counted sixty-two calls, about forty of them the same three questions. But
answering the phone is the one place your patients hear your practice, and you told
me that matters more than the money. That is worth doing carefully, second, once we
have seen a smaller change land.

**Why not the others yet:** insurance verification is probably the biggest hourly
saving here, but at six to eight new patients a week I need to watch it once before
recommending anything. Website and TikTok are marketing, not time — different
conversation, and you are not short of patients.

## What "working" looks like

> **No-shows per month**  (today: 11 → target: ___)

Set the target together once we have three months of history rather than one.

## What this does not do

- It does not answer the phone. Danny still answers the phone.
- It will not stop every no-show. People forget on purpose too.
- It does not touch insurance, the website, or TikTok.

## What I need from you

| Who | What | By |
|---|---|---|
| Danny | The three months of appointment history, however it is stored | ___ |
| Marisol | The real cost of an empty hygiene hour — you said "couple hundred, don't quote me" | ___ |
| Marisol | Approval of the exact wording patients receive, before anything sends | ___ |

**Build:** ___ · **Ongoing:** ___ /month

## Open questions

1. What does an empty hygiene hour actually cost? Everything above rests on it.
2. Where does appointment history live, and can we get three months of it?
3. Text, email, or both — and do your patients text?
4. Who signs off on the wording patients see?
5. Was sixty-two calls a normal Tuesday or a bad one?
